snippet.title: Lucky Luke - The Lonesome Cowboy Collection - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the boots of Lucky Luke, the cowboy who ”shoots faster than his own shadow.” Inspired by the satirical comics, this collection of 2D platformer games features six retro Lucky Luke titles with pixel graphics and cartoony Western charm. Saddle up for side scroller action on the frontier. 

Lucky Luke: The Lonesome Cowboy Collection is coming soon! 

Wishlist now! https://atari.com/products/lucky-luke-lonesome-cowboy-collection
